cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Make Them Your Deputy
cards.instruction: Get someone’s help by defining it as service under your direction.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I need you running the raffle table as my deputy. I've made the badge; I'll direct the draw.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why not co-organizer? I know more about the prizes than you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then prizes are your department. Choose them all, and I'll introduce you as my deputy in charge of prizes. How does that sound?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I want to announce the winners too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. I'll give you the signal for each draw, and you can announce every winner in your own style. I'll stand beside you and make sure everyone knows you're the deputy doing the work.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 recruits a deputy under draw direction; A3 concedes prize choices and A5 winner announcements while retaining signals and deputy identity to keep B participating.
